description: Frozen Phase 4 baseline experiment (original OHLCV close target, horizon=1). These results were produced on the verified dataset on the target machine and must not be overwritten. Phase 5 research targets are compared against this record.

summary_findings: Kronos lost to persistence on ALL 18 windows for close MAE, close RMSE, MAPE, return MAE and return RMSE
Kronos beat persistence on directional accuracy in all 18 windows, but persistence predicts zero return and therefore does not constitute a meaningful directional benchmark
Against previous-direction, Kronos won 16/18 MAE windows, 16/18 RMSE windows, 16/18 MAPE windows, 16/18 return MAE windows, 16/18 return RMSE windows; directional accuracy was mixed
The 1h/4h patterns are stable across older/middle/recent windows
Daily windows are smaller (~73 samples/window) and should be treated as lower-confidence evidence
Conclusion of the frozen experiment: the present Kronos-small configuration has not demonstrated incremental price-prediction value over persistence
